iteration.note: Iteration = both 10k-step runs + final eval (10k checkpoints, then 3 seeds of the best) + report.

manual._comment: Lead-maintained. build_status.py merges this with live training data into status.json. Public: no paths, emails or node names.

project.title: Hand-contact-conditioned egocentric video generation
project.one_liner: Wan2.1-Fun-1.3B-InP + a ControlNet-style adapter that follows MANO hand trajectories and per-vertex contact (Motion Prompting recipe, adapted to hands).
project.deadline_note: First-results target was Nov 13; it slipped because training only started on Nov 13. Final Phase 1 numbers expected around Nov 14 evening.

stages.name: Interface spec
stages.detail: docs/interface.md v1 approved: 512x512, 49 frames @ 16 fps, MANO + per-vertex contact (vid-haco convention).

stages.name: Data
stages.detail: 3,032 HOT3D windows (2,728 train / 304 held-out participant P0015), outcome prompts, latent cache. Tests 16/16.

stages.name: Model + smoke tests
stages.detail: Adapter = trainable copy of the first 8 DiT blocks, zero-init. Overfit test: conditioning signal grows; resume check cut off by time limit (re-checked by the step-83 resume).

stages.name: Eval harness
stages.detail: HaMeR/HACO hand metrics + Qwen2.5-VL outcome checklist. Scores real video and the base model.

stages.name: Training: no-hand control
stages.detail: v1_K8_h100_nocond on CoreWeave 8x H100: identical to v1_K8_h100 (batch 8, 10k steps, weighted loss) except --no_hand_input. ~3.6 h. Compare against v1_K8_h100 at every milestone.

stages.name: Checkpoint evals
stages.detail: Final checkpoint v1_K8_h100 @ 10k: 32.7 px capped hand error (3 seeds, A3) vs base 100.5 and real 15.0; tied with 2.5k (32.9), ahead on PCK (0.755) and idle-hand false grasps.

stages.name: Phase 1 report
stages.detail: Best checkpoint x 3 seeds vs base model and real video; sample videos.

stages.name: Phase 2: robot hands
stages.detail: Format reserved in interface.md section 6; data source not chosen yet.

needs_input.title: Paper page: title and authors
needs_input.detail: The paper-style page uses a working title and 'Authors TBD'. Send the title and author list when ready.

blockers.title: Multi-GPU runs hang on some nodes
blockers.detail: Hung twice on unicorn (4 GPUs on Nov 7, 2 GPUs on Nov 13). The CoreWeave 8x H100 run uses NVLink with P2P on and has no problems so far.

team.detail: Tracking the CoreWeave run on this dashboard; will score milestones once they reach the eval machine.
Claude session on the CoreWeave cluster: runs v1_K8_h100 and publishes status snapshots to the run-status branch.
A3 applied and all checkpoints rescored; one-hand test on 10k and 2.5k done. Next: score the no-hand control.
All data work done; not needed for the rest of Phase 1.

next_actions: v1_K8_h100_nocond trains on CoreWeave (job 254316); copy its milestones to unicorn; score them -> HOT3D adaptation vs hand following.
Phase 1 report: results table, one-hand test, demos, limitations (object identity drift, jitter).

decisions.text: Final Phase 1 checkpoint: v1_K8_h100 @ 10k (32.7 px, 3 seeds, A3). Statistical tie with 2.5k (32.9 px, Wilcoxon p = 0.80); 10k wins on PCK and idle-hand false grasps.
v1_K8_h100_nocond submitted on CoreWeave (job 254316, code 3ef6c8a) after the user confirmed.
Control = exact match (option 1) on CoreWeave: v1_K8_h100_nocond, code 3ef6c8a. The unicorn batch-2 variant was cancelled before it started.
Control moved to unicorn (user): 1 GPU, batch 2, 10k steps; matched in clips seen to v1_K8_h100 @ 2.5k (an exact batch-8 match would take ~70 h on 1 GPU).
Eval amendment A3 approved: hand-windows need >= 5 visible target frames to enter the headline; add a diagnostic left/right mismatch rate instead of re-assigning hands.
Control run approved: same fine-tune (10k steps, weighted loss) with the hand input zeroed (--no_hand_input), on CoreWeave.
One-hand test (A2) validated and run: contact selectivity base 0.09 -> trained 10k 0.28; idle hand moves 31.7 -> 9.8 px.
First trained scores: capped hand error 32 px at 2.5k/5k vs 101 px base (real 15). Best checkpoint chosen after 3-seed runs on 2.5k and 5k.
Unicorn runs v1_K8 / v1_K8_plain hard-killed: the first cancel had triggered the trainer's self-requeue, so they kept running ~4 h (no effect on results).
One-hand test approved: idle hand held at its frame-0 pose with no contact; prompt rewritten to name the acting hand.
Unicorn runs (v1_K8, v1_K8_plain) cancelled: training continues on CoreWeave only.
v1_K8_h100 launched on the CoreWeave cluster: same recipe as v1_K8, 8x H100, batch 8, ~1.2 s/step (~4 h for 10k steps). Its logs live only on CoreWeave, so it is not charted here.
After a 2-GPU communication hang, both runs moved to 1 GPU each (batch 2 per step, same ~18 h for 10k steps).
Runs resubmitted on 2 GPUs each (was 3) to start sooner; step time is unchanged, effective batch 4 instead of 6.
Progress site live at elvishh77.github.io/3dvision (dashboard + project page), refreshed every 30 min.
Training moved off culbertson to the shared gpu partition; A6000 allowed alongside 6000 Ada.
Plain-loss comparison run v1_K8_plain launched next to the weighted run.
Loss: hand weight 1, contact weight 2, with a stop rule at 5k steps.
Metrics: capped hand-keypoint error selects checkpoints; PCK@25, HACO contact F1, jitter and a Qwen2.5-VL outcome checklist are reported.
Base model Wan2.1-Fun-V1.1-1.3B-InP; 512x512, 49 frames @ 16 fps; human hands only in Phase 1.
